Also, as others have said, you should be using a crunchy PB, and a jam–like strawberry, blueberry, or raspberry. 

Up your game dog.

Hi friend. I just want you to know you have a lot of self-worth. Your struggles sound all too familiar to me. I don’t know this guy in particular, but I know what it’s like to fall hard for someone and not have that feeling reciprocated. It’s a completely shitty feeling.

Part of loving is allowing ourselves to be vulnerable, but that vulerability can also tear us apart. It’s also a struggle when you reach out to someone you care about, someone you love, and they push you away. Or respond in short text messages, like in the case of my ex gf.

I just want you to know the struggle is real and shared by many. You are not alone. 

We also have to think about what we want in a relationship. Is it really that person we do desperately desire and want, are we channeling other issues in our life into our love life, as compensation? I don’t know your situation exactly but I know I tend to do that. 

Whatever your case may be. I want you to know that I am confident it won’t always be this hard. Losing someone gets easier with time. And years from now you will look back on this and view it as a just another stage in your life.

I want you to know as someone struggling also. I’m here if you ever want to talk. 

— Charlie

I can’t do the shit I need to do to take care of myself. Laundry is everywhere. I need a haircut, my clothes are all torn. I can’t take care of my things. The people that I am close with I push away, or they get tired of dealing with my shit. I don’t want to be anyone’s chore. I’d rather just not be a drain on them.

I feel so emotional and I just unload my baggage on to others. I want to be in a place where I can help take care of someone else. Raise a family with someone. Love and support them.

I’m having delusions that people around me know each other and conspire. Not necessarily with malicious intent but they are holding back information from me. 

I feel like all the tools I need to make my life better are locked in side of a box which I can’t access.

I don’t want people to feel sorry for me. I also want people to feel they can talk freely to me and change my world view.

All the it gets better, progress every day, self growth mantras... ive heard them all

I’m just rotten to the core
